# Gotchas

Non-obvious traps. Atomic; append new ones.

## core (2)

- [[dependency-closure-is-the-whole-problem]] — Gating only the named packages is decorative — brew upgrade pulls in deps and dependents
- [[dry-run-under-reports-dependent-deps]] — brew --dry-run omits the dependencies of packages that enter the plan as dependents — this leaked the gate in production

## parsing (2)

- [[dry-run-parse-stdout-only]] — Parse brew --dry-run from stdout only — the tap-trust warning on stderr parses as package names
- [[would-install-two-column-layout]] — \"Would install N dependencies\" uses a two-column name/version layout with no arrow ⚠️

## tooling (1)

- [[kb-sync-bakes-absolute-home-path]] — kb-sync writes an absolute /Users path into INDEX.md — scrub it before every push of a public vault ⚠️

## integration (1)

- [[tap-trust-hides-third-party-taps]] — Homebrew 6 tap trust makes untrusted taps invisible — their packages cannot be aged or upgraded ⚠️

## reporting (1)

- [[transitive-hold-measured-against-plan]] — Compute the transitively-held set against the final plan, not the candidate set
